notes.text: Level 1 trade wasn't bad for Garen. Darius started with Q so he couldn't slow him with W and extend the trade. Garen may have lost more health in the initial trade, but with Doran's Shield and his passive he comes out ahead after some regeneration.
reasons: opponent opened without their extender (W slow)
health lost is regained by regen (passive, Doran's Shield)

notes.text: Got hit by Darius Q and didn't really return damage with E; he wasn't in position to.
Walked up into a bigger minion wave at level 2 vs Darius level 3. Darius could open with E, so Garen burned Flash without being able to trade back.
Darius was under Garen's tower and couldn't trade back without taking tower damage.
Not the worst, but Darius could open with E because of the earlier bad trades and the health bars, and Garen had no Flash so he had to back off sooner than he'd like.

Tried to stop Darius's back by walking up and igniting him, but could probably have got a kill or at least a Flash if he hadn't used his abilities to farm seconds before. Then went all in without Ignite and Flash and died.
reasons: abilities used on minions just before
all-in with Ignite and Flash down
